Moving Cost Estimator

Estimate DIY vs full-service moving costs from distance and home size, with a line-by-line breakdown and range.

DIY model: $150 base + $0.35/mile + $80/bedroom. Full-service: $1,200 base + $1.05/mile + $350/bedroom. Range is ±15%.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the move distance in miles and number of bedrooms.
  2. Pick DIY or full-service (or compare both).
  3. Read the estimate range and cost breakdown.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the estimates built?

Full-service = base fee + per-mile charge + per-bedroom packing/labor. DIY = truck rental + fuel per mile + supplies per bedroom. Each is shown as a ±15% range.

Are these real mover quotes?

No — these are ballpark planning figures from a simple cost model, not quotes. Get 3 real quotes before booking.

Is DIY really cheaper?

DIY is usually 50–70% cheaper for long moves, but costs you time, driving stress and heavy lifting. Compare the savings against your schedule.
